findings.title: Afternoon review: 'Place in a free block' menu opens BEHIND the review dialog, so it does nothing
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-place-open-mac.png (menu open per aria-expanded, nothing shown); eval: panel z=110, overlay z=120, panel parent BODY, topEl at item centre = 'k-btn k-btn--sm ui.menu-button'; css/tokens.css:1031-1032 (--z-menu:110, --z-modal:120); css/components.css:334 (.k-menu-panel z-index var(--z-menu)); js/core/ui.js:813 (place() appends panel to document.body); js/modules/dayreview.js:609
findings.rootCause: Menu layer token (110) below the modal layer token (120); menus are portalled to body regardless of an open modal.
findings.fix: In KOS.ui.menu place(): when the button is inside an open dialog (btn.closest('[data-ui~="ui.dialog"], .k-dialog-overlay')), append the panel inside that overlay (or set a state the CSS maps to z-index above --z-modal, e.g. a --z-menu-modal token 130). Add a smoke test that opens a menu inside openDialog and checks elementFromPoint hits the item.

findings.title: Every page header shows the PREVIOUS page's painted band after in-app navigation
findings.evidence: eval output: '#/pacing [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.pacing.webp]', '#/focus [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.calendar.webp]'; shots/productivity/focus-mac-seed.png and routines-mac-seed-2.png (sticky-note pinboard band on Focus/Routines); js/core/ui.js:589-592 (art = PAGE_ART[state.ui.view]); js/core/ui.js:1541-1543 (view rendered, then ui.view assigned)
findings.rootCause: Ordering: state.ui.view is assigned after render in KOS.show (js/core/ui.js:1543), while pageHeader reads it during render.
findings.fix: Set a module variable (e.g. KOS.ui.currentView = viewId) BEFORE calling KOS.views[viewId] and read that in pageHeader; or have each view pass opts.art explicitly. Add a smoke check: navigate A->B and assert B's band id.

findings.title: Focus: 'General study — no link' is overridden by About to Study, which silently links the session to the first assignment (even with 'Just start')
findings.evidence: eval: Focus page left on General study/no assignment -> Start focus -> preflight.just-start -> session {subject:'compsci', assignmentId:1}; shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (About to Study shows NEA); js/modules/routineplayer.js:279-287 (taskOf falls back to taskChoices()[0] when ctx has no subject/assignment), 257 (go(skip) merges task even when skip); js/modules/focus.js:2253
findings.rootCause: taskOf() treats an empty subject as 'nothing chosen' and fills it from Today's three/assignments; go(true) still merges the filled task.
findings.fix: taskOf(ctx) must respect an explicit 'no link' from the Focus page: pass ctx.explicit = true from focus.js and return {title:'General study'} without falling back; offer the ladder's suggestion as a 'Use: <task>' choice instead of a default. 'Just start' should start exactly the Focus page's config (ctx without task). Fix the menu z-index too.

findings.title: Running Focus: a long assignment title runs off the screen (left edge on Mac, right edge on iPhone)
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (left edge), shots/productivity/focus-running-iphone.png; eval: .k-fx-ctx rect x=-131..485 (mac), 32..648 (iphone, vw 402); js/modules/focus.js:879-883 (chip('課 '+asg.title), chip('due '+asg.due)), 1018, 2175; css/views/productivity.css:113-114
findings.rootCause: Chips are nowrap and the flex column is aligned to the end with no width cap, so long content overflows to the left (end-aligned) or right.
findings.fix: Give .k-fx-ctx max-inline-size:100% (min-inline-size:0 on the column) and the chip a max-inline-size with text-overflow:ellipsis (title attr for the full name); format due with KOS.ui/hub dayLabel ('due Thu 29 Oct', 'overdue 4 d'). On phone put the context card on a stronger scrim (var(--s1) at ~80%).

findings.title: Afternoon review time strip: end label '22:00 夜' overprints the last hour tick; 30-minute block text wraps to two lines
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (top-right of strip, and the 08:00 block); js/modules/dayreview.js:593-604 (tick loop t<to; tend appended unconditionally); css/views/routines.css:340-341; shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png (iPad portrait: ticks 20:00/22:00 and '22:00 夜' overprinted, '30 mi' clipped)
findings.rootCause: No collision handling between left-anchored ticks and an inline-end end label; fixed hourly tick density regardless of width.
findings.fix: Skip any tick whose position is within ~1 label width (e.g. >88%) of the end label, or render the end label as the final tick; thin ticks by available width (every 2h/3h below ~700px). For blocks narrower than the label, show the length only in the aria/tooltip or as a single-line '30m' with white-space:nowrap and no padding.

findings.title: Calendar has no Agenda (or Day) view on Mac or iPad; Agenda exists only under 700px
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png, cal-week-ipad.png, cal-month-ipadl.png (segmented control: Month | Week only); shots/productivity/calendar-iphone-seed.png (Agenda | Month); js/modules/calendar.js:1545,1562-1563,1589-1591,1613-1620
findings.rootCause: Agenda was designed as the phone composition (frame 15g) and is hard-wired to the phone branch of render().
findings.fix: Make the mode a 3-value per-device setting {month, week, agenda} (+ optional day). Factor the phone agenda list (renderPhone's day lists + agendaRows) into a renderAgenda(board) usable at any width: on desktop/iPad draw it as the board beside the existing Today/Countdowns side column (a 2-week scrolling list grouped by day with time column, hue bar, derived chips). Keep phone default Agenda; migrate stored 'week' on phone to 'agenda'.

findings.title: iPad portrait Calendar: '+ New event' wraps to its own row leaving a full-width empty band
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-ipad.png (y≈235)
findings.rootCause: .k-cal-head is a wrapping flex row with no layout tier between desktop and phone.
findings.fix: Below 1080 put Today/Show on a second toolbar row with New event at its end, or collapse '+ New event' to the '+' icon button used on phone; or let the title shrink (clamp font-size) so the row fits.

findings.title: Routine offer checkboxes render as 22x44 tall pills on touch devices
findings.evidence: measure: 'SMALL button.k-rt-check[routine.offer-pick] 22x44' on ipad and iphone; shots/productivity/routines-iphone-seed.png (tall white capsules)
findings.rootCause: Global coarse-pointer min-block-size for buttons without a matching min-inline-size on this control.
findings.fix: Give .k-rt-check an explicit aspect-ratio:1 / inline-size equal to block-size under (pointer:coarse), or keep the visual 22px box and grow the hit area with the whole row as the label (the row is already a button-like card).

findings.title: Routines 'Start with these?' card leaves ~400px dead on the right on Mac
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png
findings.fix: Either cap the card's width and place a second card beside it (e.g. Today's reviews), or lay the three template picks out as three columns across the width (they are short), or move the illustration to the right edge so the text sits between.

findings.title: Reminders: the right inspector column is a small hint card over a dead column
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/reminders-mac-seed.png, rem-today-mac.png
findings.fix: When nothing is selected, collapse the inspector and let the list widen, or fill it with useful context (Today's count, upcoming this week, 'From your plan' summary, quick-add with date).

findings.title: Reminders 'Today' leaves out overdue reminders
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/rem-today-mac.png; js/modules/reminders.js:334-349
findings.fix: Include overdue items in Today under an 'Overdue' group (count it in the Today badge or show '2 + 8 overdue'); drop the per-row chip in the plan group; align the trailing column.

findings.title: Focus page while a session is minimised is one banner over an empty page
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-page-minimised-mac.png
findings.fix: Keep the idle page's right column (Your record with today's live total, The deal with the running session's live award preview from KOS.governor.focusAward) and in place of the setup card show a compact live card: clock, cycle bar, objective, Switch…, notes, End early/Return to the stage.

findings.title: Pacing week: lesson ticks (18x18) and lesson-day selects (62x24) are far below the 44px touch minimum on iPad/iPhone
findings.evidence: measure prod/m-ipad-__pacing.json, m-iphone-__pacing.json: 'SMALL input.k-pace-tick-in 18x18', 'SMALL select.k-pace-lesson-day 62x24', 'SMALL button.k-scroller-arrow 32x32'; shots/productivity/pace-week-iphone.png
findings.fix: Make the whole lesson row a <label> for its tick (hit area = row height ≥44) and raise the day select to min-block-size 44px under (pointer:coarse) (or use the dense 24px-with-spacing exception explicitly, invariant 69).

findings.title: A routine whose steps are all optional can never be kept: ticking every step leaves it 'partial' for ever (no pay, no streak)
findings.evidence: eval prod2/rt1.js: R.add({steps:[{optional},{optional}]}) → tick both → {state:'partial', award:null}, verdict {done:false,n:0,of:0}; js/core/routines.js:316-323 (verdict: done = req.length > 0 && n === req.length); js/modules/routines.js:965-969 (Optional switch, checkMorning forces optional), 1039-1044 (save validates only step count)
findings.rootCause: verdict() has no rule for a routine with no required steps and the editor does not prevent one.
findings.fix: Either refuse to save (toast 'At least one step must be required') or judge an all-optional routine kept when every step (or any step) is ticked; the same rule in verdict() and the editor's total.

findings.title: Ticking a routine's minimum step first pays the small minimum award and locks out the full award when you then finish every step
findings.evidence: eval prod2/rt1.js: routine [full1, small(minimum), full2]: tick small → award {xp:5,gold:1,hp:2}, then tick full1 and full2 → state 'done', award null, sessions added still 1; js/core/routines.js:370-377 (pay when v.done||v.min and !e.paid), js/core/governor.js:124-131 (min → 5/1/2; 3 required → 11/1/3)
findings.rootCause: Pay-once is keyed to the first kept state rather than the best state reached that day.
findings.fix: Pay the difference when a 'min' day becomes 'done' (store e.paidAs = 'min' and top up once to the full award through one extra todo entry or by amending the award before the day closes), or pay a minimum only when the routine day ends without the full set.

findings.title: '+ New routine' with a single step silently becomes a habit and disappears into Daily habits
findings.evidence: eval prod2/rtnew.js: #/routines {edit:'new'} → add step 'Stretch, 5' → Save → record {kind:'habit', name:'Stretch'}, location #/routines/routines and the tab text does not contain it; Today's habit card shows 'Daily habits 0 of 1 today … Stretch'; js/modules/routines.js:1045 (if steps.length === 1 && kind === 'custom' && isNew → kind 'habit'), 1047 (KOS.show('routines','routines') either way)
findings.rootCause: Implicit kind conversion on save with no feedback and a fixed landing tab.
findings.fix: Keep what the user made: save a one-step routine as a routine (kind custom) unless it was started from 'Add a habit'; if converting, say so in the toast ('Saved as a habit in Daily habits') and land on Today with the habit highlighted. The redundant ternary at 1047 shows the intended branch was never written.

findings.title: Monthly reminders drift: due 31 Jan repeats 28 Feb, then 28 Mar (the day-of-month is lost after a short month)
findings.evidence: eval prod2/rem.js: add({due:'2026-01-31',recur:'monthly'}) → nextOccurrence = '2026-02-28', next of that = '2026-03-28'; js/core/reminders.js:166-187 (addMonths clamps from `cur`), compare js/modules/calendar.js:422-428 (anchored to s.getDate())
findings.rootCause: Recurrence is stepped from the last clamped date instead of the series' anchor.
findings.fix: Store the anchor day (item.recurDay = original day of month, set when recur is chosen) and compute each next occurrence as min(anchor, last day of month), like the Calendar does.

findings.title: Completing a repeating reminder cannot be undone and leaves no record: no Undo, un-tick does not restore the date, nothing in Completed
findings.evidence: eval prod2/rem.js: weekly due 22 Oct → complete → due '2026-11-12', done false, completedAt null, not in query({section:'completed'}); complete(false) → due still '2026-11-12'; js/core/reminders.js:213-250 (roll forward, no history), js/modules/reminders.js:370-375 and 546/569 (tick → complete → draw, no toast/undo); js/core/dayreview.js:300 (undo = complete(id,false))
findings.rootCause: Recurrence mutates the record in place with no undo token or completion log.
findings.fix: Have complete() return the previous {due, alerted, subs} and offer an Undo toast that restores it; keep a small completion history on the item (completions: [ts…], last 20) so Completed and Reports can show 'done 3 times'.

findings.title: Pacing 'Edit week' accepts any date as the week beginning: a mid-week date overlaps the previous week and takes over 'this week'
findings.evidence: eval: P.updateWeek('2026-11-09',{wb:'2026-11-04'}) → returned the week {wb:'2026-11-04', label:'w/c 9 Nov'}; currentWeek() → '2026-11-04 w/c 9 Nov'; weekFor('2026-11-05') → '2026-11-04'; 16 rows moved (restored afterwards); js/core/pacing.js:445-461; dialog shots/productivity/inv/e-pacing-mac.png
findings.rootCause: The week gate validates format and uniqueness, not the week grid.
findings.fix: Snap the week beginning to its Monday (or refuse a non-Monday with a message), refuse a date inside another week's 7 days, and re-derive the default label ('w/c …') when it still matches the old default.

findings.title: Daily Review marks sit in the Week view's all-day row and their time is truncated away
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png (all-day rows 5-6 chips tall); eval: 21 review chips at y 297-401; js/modules/calendar.js:600-606, 1799-1801
findings.fix: Draw timed derived marks (reviews, routine windows) as thin dashed markers in the timed grid at their time, or as one compact '朝 昼 夜' glyph row per day with the times in the tooltip/aria.

findings.title: Routines: page-header 'Templates' button duplicates the Templates tab 60px below
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed.png; js/modules/routines.js (routine.templates button)
findings.fix: Drop the header 'Templates' button (keep + New routine), or drop the Templates tab and keep the button.

findings.title: Daily habits card repeats the page sub-line, truncated, and has no add button when empty
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png (Daily habits card); measure iphone: 'OVERLAP span.k-rt-hd-m.k-ellipsis x button.k-link[routine.habits-edit]'; measure mac DEADH routine.habit-card used 95/244
findings.fix: Remove the sub-line (or make it unique, e.g. 'tick-only, auto-tracked'), and in the empty state put a primary '+ Add a habit' button in the body.

findings.title: Session review repeats '36-day streak' four times and hides what the bonus gold was for
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-review-mac.png, focus-review-iphone.png; eval KOS.governor.lastAward() = {gold:59, notes:['36-day streak'×4]}; js/core/governor.js:330-338 (notes.push(stk + '-day streak'))
findings.fix: Push one note per milestone: ms + '-day streak bonus +' + ms + ' gold' (or merge into one: 'Streak bonuses 3·7·14·30 days +54 gold'); show the session's own award and bonuses as separate lines in the review. Keep toasts above the dialog footer (offset by the footer height when a dialog is open).

findings.title: Reminders: complete circles are 32x32 on touch
findings.evidence: measure m-ipad-__reminders.json / m-iphone-__reminders.json: 'SMALL button.k-rem-check 32x32' (×28), 'SMALL select.k-pill-select 161x30'
findings.fix: Under (pointer:coarse) give .k-rem-check a 44x44 hit box (visual circle can stay 22-24px via an inner span) and the pill selects min-block-size 44px.

findings.title: Daily Review step tabs: the active tab's focus ring is clipped to two vertical crimson bars
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (around 'Time left'), dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png, dr-evening1-mac.png (around 'Tomorrow')
findings.fix: Use :focus-visible only (no ring after a pointer click) and an inset ring (outline-offset negative or box-shadow inset) so the scroller's overflow cannot clip it.

findings.title: Evening review: 'Tomorrow's first task' says nothing is due while overdue plan rows exist; lesson rows show bare dashes
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-evening1-mac.png; js/modules/dayreview.js:585 (empty-candidates text)
findings.fix: Feed carried-over plan rows (KOS.pacing.dueThisWeek().carried) and the Focus ladder's next into the candidates; omit the time cell (or show 'lesson') when a lesson has no time.

findings.title: Running Focus in a break: red 'End early' stays in the header beside 'End session'
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-stage-break-mac.png
findings.fix: Hide 'End early' (or relabel it 'End' in neutral style) when canComplete() is true.

findings.title: Routines Today: three equal columns stretch the reviews and habits cards to the routine card's height
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/rt-today-mac.png
findings.fix: Give the routine card 2 of 3 columns (or a full row) and stack reviews + habits in the third column; align-items:start for the side cards.

findings.title: Afternoon review 'Tomorrow' on a plan row says 'moved to tomorrow' when nothing moved
findings.evidence: js/core/dayreview.js:314-319 (plan: no write, res.note), js/modules/dayreview.js:621 (toast 'moved to tomorrow' on r.ok, note ignored) vs 532 (note shown)
findings.rootCause: Two callers of triage() handle its result differently.
findings.fix: Show r.note when present, or do not offer 'Tomorrow' for plan rows (offer 'Remind me tomorrow', which creates a reminder).

findings.title: Time-left strip's end label always reads the evening review time even when the strip runs past it (after ~21:00 two '22:00' labels, or the tick under the end label)
findings.evidence: eval prod2/place.js at 18:52: ticks [19:00 248-281, 20:00 588-621, 21:00 927-960], end 1210-1261; shots/productivity/inv/dr-time-mac.png; js/modules/dayreview.js:593-605 (to = Math.max(mins(until), from + 60); end label text = until)
findings.rootCause: The bar's span and its end label come from different values.
findings.fix: End the strip at the evening time (to = mins(until)) and when less than an hour is left draw it shorter, or label the end with the real end; skip an hour tick within ~40 px of the end label.

findings.title: Review times can be set out of order and a later slot then folds a review that has not happened yet
findings.evidence: eval: setConfig({slots:{morning:{weekday:'19:00'}}}) → due(17:00 Mon) = {slot:'afternoon', folded:['morning']}; js/core/dayreview.js:90-100 (no ordering), 166-176 (due iterates slots in fixed order)
findings.rootCause: The settings gate validates each time alone.
findings.fix: Clamp in the gate (morning < afternoon < evening, at least 30 min apart) and say so in Settings next to the time inputs; or have due() fold only slots whose time has passed.

findings.title: Auto-tracked Focus habits count aborted sessions and split a late-night session at midnight instead of at the routine day start
findings.evidence: eval prod2/auto.js: baseline focus/maths today 19 min → after pushing an incomplete 540 s maths focus entry 28 min; reading (media) sessions correctly ignored; js/core/routines.js:628-645 (e.date !== day; no complete check), 676-678 (day = routineDay(now))
findings.rootCause: The habit reads the Goals engine's calendar-day convention inside the routine-day model.
findings.fix: Decide and document: count only sessions with metrics.complete (or full 10-minute blocks, matching the pay rule), and measure by the routine day (filter on routineDay(e.ts) rather than e.date).

findings.title: Calendar: a repeating event can only be edited or deleted as a whole series; no 'this showing only', and an event cannot run past midnight
findings.evidence: js/modules/calendar.js:1100-1105 (confirmDelete: whole series), 409-431 (occursOn reads ext.g.skip only), 1359-1361 (end <= start refused)
findings.rootCause: Recurrence exceptions were built only for the Google two-way sync.
findings.fix: Add 'Skip this showing' (a local skip list on the record, read by occursOn) and 'Edit only this showing' (skip + a one-off copy); allow an end time on the next day ('ends next day' when end < start).

findings.title: Routine player's finish screen says '炎 1 days'
findings.evidence: eval prod2/player.js: Morning Routine played to the end → finished text 'Morning Routine kept · 7 of 7 · +23 XP · 2 gold · +4 HP · 炎 1 days'; js/modules/routineplayer.js:182
findings.rootCause: Hand-built string without pluralisation.
findings.fix: Use the shared plural helper ('1 day', '2 days'), or the streak chip used elsewhere on Routines.

findings.title: A routine's time window never closes it: a Morning routine played at 19:00 is kept, paid and streaked as on time
findings.evidence: eval prod2/player.js at 19:03: fromTemplate('morning') (window from the template) → player → 7 of 7, award {xp:23,gold:2}, state 'done'; js/core/routines.js:357-379 (tick: no window check), 451-452 (setRest refuses after w.to)
findings.rootCause: The window is used for reminders and display only, not for judging the day.
findings.fix: Decide the rule: either record e.late/e.outside when the day is kept after window.to (shown as 'kept late' in History, still paid), or close the day at window end + grace for streak purposes. At minimum show 'outside its window' in the player.

findings.title: Daily habits editor: Save and Cancel sit inside the 'How habits work' help card, which stretches to the habit list's height
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/inv/habits-edit-mac.png; measure: DEADH section.k-card 'Daily habits' used 177/319 (earlier sweep), help card 970–1446 x 366–657 with Save at y≈498
findings.rootCause: Actions appended to the last side card; cards stretch in the grid row.
findings.fix: Put Save/Cancel in a sticky footer under the habit list (as the routine editor does) or in the page header's action slot; let the help card size to its content (align-self:start).

findings.title: Touch sizes on Focus setup and Routines settings: selects 39 px tall, time inputs 42 px, switches 34x20
findings.evidence: prod2/s-ipad-__focus.json, s-iphone-__focus.json, s-ipad-__routines_settings.json, s-iphone-__routines_settings.json, s-ipad-__reminders.json (SMALL lines)
findings.rootCause: The touch minimum in components.css raises buttons but not inputs, selects or switch tracks.
findings.fix: Apply the coarse-pointer min-block-size token to .k-input/.k-select/.k-pill-select, and give .k-switch a 44 px hit area through its label (padding on the label, not the track).

findings.title: Morning review summary prints '11 days away..' and lower-cases the exam's name
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.reviewSheet.open('morning') → '…Exam season is on: revision block 24 is 11 days away.. A good first task: …'; shots/productivity/inv/dr-morning-ipad.png; js/core/dayreview.js:540, js/core/exams.js:1077-1078 (body ends with '.')
findings.rootCause: String concatenation that assumes the notice body has no punctuation and no proper nouns.
findings.fix: Strip a trailing full stop before appending and do not lower-case the body (lower-case only its first letter when it is not part of a title, or reword the line).

findings.title: Calendar event modal: Cancel floats in the middle of the footer on a new event
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/inv/cal-modal-mac.png; js/modules/calendar.js:1442-1447; css/components.css:382 (.k-dialog-foot > :first-child:not(:only-child) { margin-inline-end: auto }), css/layout.css:363 (.k-spacer { margin-inline-start: auto })
findings.rootCause: Two auto-margin rules apply to the same element when Delete is absent.
findings.fix: Drop k-spacer from Cancel and let the danger button carry margin-inline-end:auto (productivity.css:601 already does); or render an empty start slot.

findings.title: Routines Today: 'Today's three' rows clip their titles mid-letter with no ellipsis, and the ○ mark shrinks so rows misalign
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/inv/rt-three-crop.png (2x), shots/productivity/inv/dawn-routines-mac.png; eval: rows → mark W12/W12/W22, title L282/L282/L292, title computed display:flex overflow:hidden text-overflow:ellipsis scrollWidth 685 > 310; js/modules/routines.js:566; css/views/routines.css:15 (.k-rt-grow display:flex), 41 (.k-rt-mark no flex-shrink)
findings.rootCause: An ellipsis utility applied to an element another class turns into a flex container.
findings.fix: Use a plain block for single-line text (drop k-rt-grow or add .k-rt-grow.k-ellipsis{display:block}) and give .k-rt-mark flex:none. The same 'k-rt-grow k-ellipsis' pairing appears in other routine/review rows; fix it once in the CSS.

findings.title: Reminder alert notifications read 'Reminder · due 10 minutes to go' / 'due 1 day to go'
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.reminders.forecast() for a reminder due tomorrow 09:00 with alerts [10] → body 'Reminder · due 10 minutes to go'; all-day due in 2 days → 'Reminder · due now' at 09:00; js/core/reminders.js:460-464
findings.rootCause: String substitution on the option labels.
findings.fix: Word it as 'Due in 10 minutes · 09:00' / 'Due tomorrow' / 'Due today' from the actual offset and time.

findings.title: Pacing 'Edit week' dialog on Mac: 'My week' sits alone on its own row under 'Week beginning' while 'School week' is in the row above
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/inv/e-pacing-mac.png (dialog 375–1095 px; My week 403–616 px, nothing to its right)
findings.rootCause: Grid auto-placement with a hint paragraph that pushes the fourth field to a new row.
findings.fix: Two rows: Week beginning · Label, then School week · My week (or put the hint under Week beginning in a full-width row).

findings.title: Achievement progress pings sit exactly over the section strip (Productivity/Study pills) and blend with it while fading
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/inv/pace-classdays-mac.png (top-left, 220–560 x 72–135); css/views/achievements.css:270 (.k-ach-pings position), js/modules/achievements.js:693-712
findings.rootCause: The ping position was chosen without the section strip that occupies it on every section page.
findings.fix: Anchor pings to the bottom-left (above the HUD) or the top-right under the header chip, away from in-page navigation.
